cases.sentence: Страна была покорена ими, 2 но семь ___ еще не получили своего удела.
cases.explain: «израильских родов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The whole congregation of the children of Israel assembled themselves together at Shiloh, and set up the Tent of Meeting there. The land was subdued before them.

cases.sentence: Но левиты не получат надела между вами, потому что их удел — ___ Господа.
cases.explain: «священническая служба» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Yahweh is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them.”

cases.sentence: А Гад, Рувим и половина рода Манассии уже получили свои наделы на ___ Иордана.

cases.translation: However, the Levites have no portion among you; for the priesthood of Yahweh is their inheritance. Gad, Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance east of the Jordan, which Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them.”

cases.sentence: И Иисус бросил о них жребий в Шило перед Господом и распределил израильтянам землю по их ___.
cases.explain: «родовым разделениям» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Joshua cast lots for them in Shiloh before Yahweh. There Joshua divided the land to the children of Israel according to their divisions.

cases.sentence: От холма, что напротив Бет-Хорона, на юге граница поворачивала к югу по ___ надела и заканчивалась у Кирьят-Баала (то есть Кирьят-Иеарима), города народа Иуды.
cases.explain: «западной стороне» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.

cases.explain: «западная граница» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The border extended, and turned around on the west quarter southward, from the mountain that lies before Beth Horon southward; and ended at Kiriath Baal (also called Kiriath Jearim), a city of the children of Judah. This was the west quarter.

cases.sentence: ___ шла от предместий Кирьят-Иеарима на западе и оттуда к источнику вод Нефтоах.
cases.explain: «Южная граница» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The south quarter was from the farthest part of Kiriath Jearim. The border went out westward, and went out to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah.

cases.sentence: Она нисходила долиной Гинном по ___ города иевусеев к Эн-Рогелу.

cases.translation: The border went down to the farthest part of the mountain that lies before the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is in the valley of Rephaim northward. It went down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite southward, and went down to En Rogel.

cases.sentence: Она тянулась к ___ Бет-Аравы и спускалась в саму иорданскую долину.
cases.explain: «северному склону» — after the preposition «к», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: It passed along to the side opposite the Arabah northward, and went down to the Arabah.

cases.translation: The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.
